h2: Jaguar F-Type AJ133 V8|Timing Chain Issue?|
description: If your F-Type is a 2012–2014 model fitted with the 5.0L supercharged AJ133 V8, this engine carries the same documented timing chain tensioner design flaw found on the equivalent-era XJ, XK and XF — serious enough to have been named directly in a US class-action lawsuit alongside those models.

callout.title: A Well-Documented Issue
callout.body: Ingenium AJ200 injector seal leaks and timing chain wear are widely documented across Jaguar specialist forums and official TSBs.

heroHook.title: Include In Hero Hook:
heroHook.body: Yes — both verified: Ingenium AJ200 widely documented with multiple TSBs; M156 pre-2012 established Jaguar specialist pattern.

features.title: New Timing Chains
features.body: Replaced as standard (where worn or damaged)

features.title: Peace Of Mind
features.body: No hidden extras — just a stronger, longer-lasting engine
